payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the manual Pyramid scores used in summarization evaluation, including the structure of the Pyramid and its correlation with other metrics.

claims.text: The manual Pyramid scores are based on the organization of content units in a pyramid structure, where higher tiers indicate higher importance of content units.
Different variants of the Pyramid scores correlate with various evaluation metrics, with some variants of Rouge showing weak correlations with manual Pyramid scores.
The proposed metric Sera (Summarization Evaluation by Relevance Analysis) achieves higher correlations with manual Pyramid scores compared to Rouge.
